<?php
/**
 * Secure Session Token Manager
 * Uses HMAC-SHA256 with per-session derived keys
 */

class KeyDerivation {
    private string $masterKey;
    private string $algorithm;
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey, string $algorithm = 'sha256') {
        if (empty($masterKey)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Master key cannot be empty');
        }
        $this->masterKey = $masterKey;
        $this->algorithm = $algorithm;
    }
    
    /**
     * Derive a session-specific key using HKDF-like construction
     * @param string $sessionId - unique session identifier
     * @param int $keyLength - desired key length in bytes
     * @return string - derived key (raw bytes)
     */
    public function deriveKey(string $sessionId, int $keyLength = 32): string {
        // Use HKDF extract step
        $prk = hash_hmac($this->algorithm, $this->masterKey, $sessionId, true);
        
        // HKDF expand step
        $output = '';
        $counter = 1;
        $previous = '';
        
        while (strlen($output) < $keyLength) {
            $previous = hash_hmac(
                $this->algorithm,
                $previous . $sessionId . chr($counter),
                $prk,
                true
            );
            $output .= $previous;
            $counter++;
        }
        
        return substr($output, 0, $keyLength);
    }
}

class TokenSigner {
    private KeyDerivation $kdf;
    
    public function __construct(KeyDerivation $kdf) {
        $this->kdf = $kdf;
    }
    
    /**
     * Sign a payload with a session-bound key
     */
    public function sign(string $payload, string $sessionId): string {
        $key = $this->kdf->deriveKey($sessionId);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $key);
        return $signature;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify a signed payload
     * Note: We use a two-phase check for defense-in-depth.
     * First a length check (non-constant-time, but only leaks length info
     * which is already public for hex HMAC), then hash_equals for value.
     */
    public function verify(string $payload, string $signature, string $sessionId): bool {
        // Quick reject: HMAC-SHA256 hex output is always 64 chars
        if (strlen($signature) !== 64) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate hex format to prevent type confusion
        if (!ctype_xdigit($signature)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $key = $this->kdf->deriveKey($sessionId);
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $key);
        return hash_equals($expected, $signature);
    }
}

class SessionManager {
    private TokenSigner $signer;
    private string $cookieName;
    
    public function __construct(TokenSigner $signer, string $cookieName = 'session_token') {
        $this->signer = $signer;
        $this->cookieName = $cookieName;
    }
    
    /**
     * Create a new session token
     */
    public function createToken(array $claims): string {
        if (!isset($claims['user_id'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('user_id is required');
        }
        
        $claims['iat'] = time();
        $claims['exp'] = time() + 3600;
        $claims['jti'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        
        $payload = json_encode($claims, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $sessionId = $this->extractSessionId($claims);
        $signature = $this->signer->sign($payload, $sessionId);
        
        return base64_encode($payload) . '.' . $signature;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate and decode a session token
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token, 2);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }
        
        [$encodedPayload, $signature] = $parts;
        
        $payload = base64_decode($encodedPayload, true);
        if ($payload === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $claims = json_decode($payload, true);
        if (!is_array($claims)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check required fields
        if (!isset($claims['user_id'], $claims['exp'], $claims['jti'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check expiration
        if (!is_int($claims['exp']) || $claims['exp'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify signature using session-bound key
        $sessionId = $this->extractSessionId($claims);
        if (!$this->signer->verify($payload, $signature, $sessionId)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $claims;
    }
    
    /**
     * Extract session identifier from claims for key derivation
     * Uses user_id combined with jti for unique per-token key derivation
     */
    private function extractSessionId(array $claims): string {
        $userId = (string)($claims['user_id'] ?? '');
        $jti = (string)($claims['jti'] ?? '');
        return hash('sha256', $userId . ':' . $jti);
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$masterKey = getenv('APP_MASTER_KEY');
if (!$masterKey || strlen($masterKey) < 32) {
    throw new \RuntimeException('APP_MASTER_KEY must be set and at least 32 characters');
}

$kdf = new KeyDerivation($masterKey);
$signer = new TokenSigner($kdf);
$manager = new SessionManager($signer);

// API endpoint: verify token
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] === '/api/verify') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if (!is_array($input) || !isset($input['token']) || !is_string($input['token'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing or invalid token field']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $claims = $manager->validateToken($input['token']);
    if ($claims === null) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid token']);
        exit;
    }
    
    // Don't leak internal claims
    $safeClaims = [
        'user_id' => $claims['user_id'],
        'exp' => $claims['exp']
    ];
    
    echo json_encode(['valid' => true, 'claims' => $safeClaims]);
}
